```{r}
#| label: survey-gender
#| include: false

# # IRT data (replacing mrot_df)
# mrot_scores <- readr::read_rds(here::here("models/mrot_scores.rds")) |>
#   filter(model_set == "multigroup_site") # also contains "multigroup_dataset"

survey_gender <- readr::read_rds(
  here::here("survey", "survey_gender_conditions.rds")
)
# colnames(survey_gender)

survey_gender_wide <- survey_gender |>
  filter(variable %in% c("ChildSexBirth", "ChildGenderCurrent")) |>
  select(child_id, variable, string_response) |>
  group_by(child_id, variable) |>
  # keep non-NA if available, otherwise NA
  summarise(string_response = na.omit(string_response) |> unique() |> 
              (\(x) if(length(x) == 1) x else NA_character_)(),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = string_response) |>
  rename(sex = ChildSexBirth, 
         gender = ChildGenderCurrent)
```

```{r}
#| label: survey-gender-distributions

table(survey_gender_wide$sex, useNA = "always")
table(survey_gender_wide$gender, useNA = "always")
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

# Run data
run_data <- readr::read_rds(here::here("data/runs_mrot.rds"))

# RT data
task_data <- readr::read_rds(here::here("data/task_data_nested.rds"))

# IRT data
mrot_scores <- readr::read_rds(here::here("models/mrot_scores.rds")) |>
  filter(model_set == "multigroup_site") # also contains "multigroup_dataset"

# coefficients
mrot_coefs <- readr::read_rds(here::here("models/mrot_coef.rds"))

# survey data for gender analysis
survey_gender <- readr::read_rds(
  here::here("survey", "survey_gender_conditions.rds")
)

site_labels <- c("uniandes-co" = "pilot_uniandes_co",
                 "mpieva-de" = "pilot_mpieva_de",
                 "western-ca" = "pilot_western_ca")

mrot_df <- mrot_scores |>
  inner_join(runs_filtered)

```

```{r}
#| label: filter-runs

# apply filters to runs for use in all subsequent analyses
min_trials <- 10
min_gap_months <- 3
run_data_filtered <- run_data |>
  filter(num_attempted >= min_trials) |>
  filter(!is.na(age), age >= 5, age <= 14) |>
  arrange(user_id, age) |>
  group_by(user_id) |>
  mutate(run_number = row_number(),
         age_gap = age - lag(age)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter_out(age_gap < min_gap_months / 12) |>
  select(site, user_id, run_id, age, adaptive)

# create age groups based on roughly equal sample sizes
n_groups <- 3
ages <- run_data_filtered |> pull(age)
age_breaks <- quantile(ages, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_groups + 1))

# add age groups and site labels
runs_filtered <- run_data_filtered |>
  mutate(age_group = cut(age, breaks = age_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
         site_label = site |>
           recode_values(from = site_labels, to = names(site_labels)))
```

```{r}
#| label: build-trial-data

mrot_rt_trial <- task_data |>
  select(site, data) |>
  unnest(data) |>
  inner_join(runs_filtered) |>
  select(site, site_label, user_id, run_id, adaptive, age, age_group, trial_id,
         trial_number, item_uid, item_group, item, item_original, correct, rt_numeric) |>
  mutate(
    correct    = as.integer(correct),
    rt_s       = as.numeric(rt_numeric) / 1000,
    log_rt     = log(rt_s),
    angle      = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(item, "(?<=_)\\d+")),
    angle_full = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(item_original, "\\d{3}$")),
    stimulus = stringr::str_extract(item, "^[a-z]+")
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(rt_s), rt_s > 0)

```

#| label: de-sex-data

  rename(user_id = uid, sex = Gender) |>
  mutate(sex_demo = recode_values(sex, "m" ~ "Male", "f" ~ "Female"))


# number of DE users
n_distinct(mrot_df$user_id[mrot_df$site_label == "mpieva-de"])

# number overlapping with data
length(intersect(de_sex$user_id, mrot_df$user_id))

# number overlapping with surveys
length(intersect(de_sex$user_id, survey_gender_wide$child_id))

sex_data <- full_join(de_sex, 
          rename(survey_gender_wide, sex_survey = sex), 
          by = c("user_id" = "child_id"))

sex_data |>
  filter_out(is.na(sex_survey) | is.na(sex_demo)) |>
  filter(sex_demo != sex_survey)

de_sex_cleaned <- de_sex |>
  transmute(user_id, sex = sex_demo)

```{r}
#| label: co-sex-data

co_sex <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("demographics_data", "infoUsuariosLevante_expanded.xlsx"))

# check column names and structure
colnames(co_sex)
glimpse(co_sex)

# see the first few rows
head(co_sex)

sum(co_sex$`user_id 2025` %in% mrot_df$user_id)
sum(co_sex$`user_id_Pil 2024` %in% mrot_df$user_id)

co_sex_cleaned <- co_sex |>
  rename(user_id = `user_id 2025`) |>
  distinct(user_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>  # remove duplicate rows
  filter(!is.na(Sex)) |>
  transmute(
    user_id,
    sex = recode_values(Sex, "F" ~ "Female", "M" ~ "Male")
  )

# check duplicates
# any duplicate user_ids in the CO data?
co_sex |> count(`user_id 2025`) |> filter(n > 1)

# any users appearing in both DE and CO datasets?
intersect(de_sex$user_id, co_sex$`user_id 2025`)

co_sex |>
  group_by(`user_id 2025`) |>
  filter(n() > 1) |>
  summarise(n_sex_values = n_distinct(Sex, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  count(n_sex_values)

```

```{r}
#| label: combine-sex-data

# add survey data
survey_sex_cleaned <- survey_gender_wide |>
  filter(!is.na(sex)) |>
  transmute(user_id = child_id, sex)

sex_data_cleaned <- bind_rows(de_sex_cleaned, co_sex_cleaned, survey_sex_cleaned) |>
  distinct(user_id, .keep_all = TRUE)  # demographic files take priority over survey
```

```{r}
#| label: sex-coverage-summary

mrot_rt_trial |> 
  distinct(user_id) |> 
  nrow()

mrot_rt_trial |>
  left_join(sex_data_cleaned) |>
  distinct(user_id, site, sex) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_with_sex = sum(!is.na(sex)),
    pct = round(100 * n_with_sex / n_total, 1)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: sex-irt-plot

mrot_df_sex <- inner_join(mrot_df, sex_data_cleaned, by = "user_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(sex))

# add sample sizes
site_n_labels <- mrot_df_sex |>
  distinct(user_id, site_label) |>
  count(site_label) |>
  mutate(label = paste0(site_label, "\n(n = ", n, ")"))

mrot_df_sex <- mrot_df_sex |>
  left_join(site_n_labels) |>
  mutate(site_label_n = label)

ggplot(mrot_df_sex, aes(x = age, y = metric_value, colour = sex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.1) +
  geom_line(aes(group = user_id), alpha = .3) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(
    x      = "Age (years)",
    y      = "Ability (θ)",
    colour = "Sex"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~site_label_n) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
